verification_summary.balance_notes: Race banks-mayor. Bogroff has 4 bio and 4 positions (2 T1, 2 T2). Kirk has 4 bio and 2 positions (all T1); her campaign site blocked fetches and her pamphlet has few specifics (documented). The imbalance comes from source availability, not effort. Possibly missed: KOIN 'Mayor Monday: Community updates from Banks' (syndicated on Yahoo), which may contain Kirk's own statements as sitting mayor. It was not fetched. File-level: name matches pamphlet/official listing. Incumbent false: the 2026 pamphlet shows Kirk as Mayor 2025–present and lists Bogroff only on the Planning Commission. Source changed from the Feb 2025 minutes. Website https://www.jimmybogroff.com confirmed as printed in the 2026 county pamphlet.
